entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2007997408188526336 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/ak-cep/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv; cross-identification HIP 110964: https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia+DR3+2007997408188526336. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AK Cep: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 4035.8 +/- 628 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 4035.8 +/- 628 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2314 +/- 0.0163 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12), 14.2 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -3.137, -2.691 mas/yr. Radial velocity: Gaia DR3 (same row): -57.18 +/- 4.30 km/s.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 59.5 +/- 9.7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, AK Cep: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 59.5 +/- 9.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 41,394,150 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5375 +/- 168 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 359, Name='AK Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5375 +/- 168 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 2007997408188526336: 5 G-band harmonics of a 7.232410037318362 d period, peak-to-peak 0.494 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.02 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,375 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.635 +/- 0.049 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffecdd. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,375 K and log g 2.12 (u1 0.527, u2 0.213): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.

entries.subject: Surface gravity
entries.finding: Published: log g 2.12 from 2011AJ....142..136L; the 1 published value span log g 2.12 to 2.12, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.0% of the centre brightness.
